subject: general
question: How many bronze medals did India win at the Paralympic Games held in Tokyo in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2020 Paralympics** were **held in Tokyo**, Japan in August-September 2021.
 
• **India** finished at **24th place** in the medal standings with **5 gold**, **8 silver** and **6 bronze** medals with a **total** tally of **19 medals**.
 
• India has improved its performance when compared to the previous year and is the highest to date.
 
• **China** stood at the **top of the table** with 207 medals.
 
• Flag bearer :
 
 
• **Tek Chand** (opening) (javelin throw)
 
• **Avani Lekhara** (closing) (Shooting)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avani Lekhara**

 
 
• She is the **1st Indian woman to win 2 Paralympic medals** in a single edition of the Paralympic Games.
 
• She was **awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in 2021.
 
• She won the medals(Gold and Bronze) in the Shooting category.
 
 
 
• Gold medalists(Paralympics 2020) :
 
 
• **Sumit Antil** (Javelin), **Pramod Bhagat** (Badminton), **Krishna Nagar** (Badminton), **Avani Lekhara** (shooting), **Manish Narwal**(Shooting)
 
 
 
• India medals in **Tokyo Olympics**: Total of **7 medals** (1 gold, 2 Silver, 4 Bronze)
 
• Summer Olympics 2024: Paris
 
• Winter Olympics 2026: Milan-Cortina (Italy)
